sourceAccess: Already connected and authorized native GPT Finance read capabilities
toolMapping: Discover the actual tool names and input schemas in the current host. These roles are not callable tool names.

roles.accounts: Complete linked-account read (get_linked_accounts in the existing Finance contract)
roles.bank: bank_transactions for the exact window, all accounts, transfers included, no pending filter
roles.inflows: Independent bank_transactions query for the same window, amount less than zero, pending false, transfers included
roles.investments: All investment_transactions for the exact window and all accounts

pagination.continue: Use each exact returned next_cursor until has_more is false
